exceptionRules.exceptionStatement: A historical secret already rotated and confirmed invalid may be logged as accepted residual history rather than requiring history rewrite, subject to Security Engineering sign-off.
exceptionRules.exceptionScope: This specific historical commit range only
exceptionRules.reviewRequirements: Rotation and invalidation must be independently confirmed before acceptance.
